ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Treasury_Corporate]
AS
BEGIN



DROP TABLE  DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate;

WITH DimCustomerAccount_TRY AS
(
    SELECT
        DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate ,DB.BankId
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DB ON DCA.BankSK = DB.BankSK 
    WHERE DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = '1' AND DB.BankID IN ('CBC01', 'CBC11')
),
CustomerAccountBalance AS
(
SELECT CustomerAccountId,BalanceTypeId,Timestamp,IsoCurrencyCode, SUM(BalanceAmount) BalanceAmount FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance WHERE BalanceTypeId IN ('Fixed Income Product Outstanding', 'Money Market Product Outstanding', 'Structured Product PYA Outstanding', 'Structured Product Asset Swap')
AND SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' AND IsoCurrencyCode = 'PHP'
GROUP BY 
CustomerAccountId, BalanceTypeId, Timestamp, IsoCurrencyCode


)
, CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation
AS(
SELECT CustomerAccountId, COUNT(CUSTOMERID) CNT FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation where SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' 
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId 
)

SELECT 
    DCA.AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID
    ,CASE WHEN DC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DCA.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DBr.BranchID as BranchCode
    ,DBr.BranchName
    ,DBr.Area
    ,DBr.Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode
    ,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,DP.ProductName as ProductType
    ,CONCAT(DP.ProductGroup,'-',DP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ,DCA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,BCAB.BalanceAmount AS OutstandingInvestmentFull
    ,BCAB.BalanceAmount / CNT AS OutstandingInvestmentProrated
    ,convert(varchar,BCAB.[Timestamp],112) AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DP.ProductName,DCA.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey    
    INTO DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate
FROM DimCustomerAccount_TRY DCA
JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK ,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerType = 'Corporate') DC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct) DAP ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchSK ,BranchID ,BranchName ,Area ,Region FROM DW.DimBranch) DBr ON DCA.BranchSK = DBr.BranchSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSK ,ProductGroup ,ProductName FROM DW.DimProduct) DP ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK ---- NO DATA
--LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,OutstandingInvestmentFull ,OutstandingInvestmentProrated ,BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment )) FTOI ON DCA.AccountSK = FTOI.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN CustomerAccountBalance BCAB ON DCA.AccountID = BCAB.CustomerAccountId AND DP.ProductName = BCAB.BalanceTypeId
LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation BCAP ON BCAB.CustomerAccountId = BCAP.CustomerAccountId --join for count
GROUP BY 
DCA.AccountID
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF
,DC.SourceSystemCode
,DC.CustomerID
,DCA.BankID
,DBr.BranchID
,DBr.BranchName
,DBr.Area
,DBr.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DP.ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName
,DCA.AccountOpenedDate
,BCAB.BalanceAmount
,BCAB.[Timestamp]
,DCA.ValidStartDate
,CNT
END
